rubric.reasoning_layers: At least two linked deductions, constraints or conditional checks in every non-trivial item.

questions.text: Passage 1 is principally arguing that: Use the vending-permit register as the complete information set for this question.
options: That urban water resilience can be solved through one nationwide institutional reform under all conditions.
That urban water resilience requires aligned incentives, evidence and local feedback rather than one universal prescription.
That urban water resilience should be left to spontaneous private action without accountable public oversight.

questions.text: Passage 1 most clearly permits which inference? Use the safety-inspection file as the complete information set for this question.
options: Measurement adds little when an intervention has a persuasive and desirable objective.
Administrative discretion is always harmful, even when evidence reveals local constraints.
An intervention may fail despite a desirable objective when its feedback loop remains weak.
A locally successful intervention will work identically elsewhere without any adaptation or review.

questions.text: The reasoning in Passage 1 depends on which assumption? Use the forest-response dashboard as the complete information set for this question.

Institutional learning can improve policy without requiring perfect foresight at the outset.
Local actors always possess complete information before implementation begins.

questions.text: If r is the remainder when 5^18 + 6^16 is divided by 14, what is r? Use the clinic-referral diary as the complete information set for this question.
questions.solution: Compute powers modulo 14; cyclic reduction gives remainder 9.

questions.text: How many integers from 1 through 98, inclusive, are divisible by 7 or 12, but not by both? Use the market-access survey as the complete information set for this question.
questions.solution: Count multiples of 7 and 12, then remove twice the common multiples: the exclusive count is 20.

questions.text: Solution A contains 27% solute and solution B contains 15% solute. If A and B are mixed in the volume ratio 6:1, what is the resulting concentration? Use the ward-grievance register as the complete information set for this question.
questions.solution: Use a weighted average: (6×27+15)/(6+1) = 25.29%.

questions.text: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G sit in a row. C is third from the left; A is left of D; B and F are non-adjacent; G is not at an end. Which person cannot occupy fifth position? Use the ration audit as the complete information set for this question.

D
B
C
questions.solution: Enumerating all valid arrangements gives possible fifth-position occupants ['A', 'B', 'D', 'E', 'F', 'G']; C never appears there.

questions.text: M is the sister of N. N is the father of P. P is the daughter of Q. Relative to P, what is M? Use the vending-permit register as the complete information set for this question.
options: P's paternal cousin
P's maternal aunt
P's paternal aunt
P's grandmother
questions.solution: N is P's father; M is N's sister, so M is P's paternal aunt.

questions.text: Exactly one of A, B and C is guilty and exactly one statement is true. A says B is guilty; B says A and C are innocent; C says B is innocent. Who is guilty? Use the safety-inspection file as the complete information set for this question.
options: A only
C only
No one
B only
questions.solution: Assume exactly one of A, B and C is guilty and exactly one statement is true. A says B is guilty; B says A and C are innocent; C says B is innocent. Testing A, B and C in turn leaves only B guilty: A and C are then false, while B is true.

questions.text: In a drought-prone taluk, a file concerning tank-restoration grants is being reviewed by panchayat engineers; the available evidence includes worksite measurements. Suspend the entire programme immediately without checking either source of information.
Treat oral reports as conclusive because lived experience cannot contain measurement error.

questions.solution: Triangulation tests measurement and lived experience before a consequential administrative action.
